description: Physical goods with no exemption (the default category)
Items the seller has marked as not subject to sales tax
Clothing and shoes; Washington has no clothing exemption
Food and food ingredients for home consumption (RCW 82.08.0293)
Candy and gum; Washington exempts candy with other food (RCW 82.08.0293)
Food heated or mixed by the seller, or sold with utensils (excluded from the food exemption)
Sweetened non-alcoholic drinks; not drinks with milk or over 50% juice (excluded from the food exemption)
Bottled water (excluded from the food exemption)
Vitamins and supplements sold without a prescription (excluded from the food exemption)
Drugs dispensed under a prescription (RCW 82.08.0281)
Medicine sold without a prescription
Newspapers (RCW 82.08.0253); SST has no uniform definition, each state sets its own
Digital goods in general: downloaded or streamed music, movies, books and similar
Movies, shows and other video, downloaded or streamed
Songs, audiobooks and other audio, downloaded or streamed
E-books
Prewritten (off-the-shelf) software on a physical medium
Prewritten software delivered electronically (downloaded)
Software used online without downloading it (SaaS); Washington taxes it as prewritten software
Delivery charges are taxed in the same share as the goods delivered (by price)
